a: वध्य — a. 1 To be killed or slain. --2 Sentenced to be killed. --3 Vulnerable. --4 To be subjected to corporeal punishment, to be corporeally punished. --ध्यः 1 A victim, one seeking his doom; Mu. 1. 9. --2 An enemy. --Comp. --पटहः a drum beaten at the time of execution. --भूः, --भूमिः f., --स्थलं, --स्थानं a place of execution. --माला a garland of flowers placed on a person who is about to be executed. --शिला {1} an executioner's block, scaffold. {2} a slaughter-house.

m: वध्य—भू or वध्य—भूमि, f. a place of public execution, Kathās.
वध्य—घातक (L.) mfn. killing one sentenced to death, executing criminals.
वध्य—घ्न (MBh.) mfn. killing one sentenced to death, executing criminals.
